title: Radioactive Skulls
description: Changes the way skulls are rendered so they will be displayed even when they are not in your view
body:
What is Radioactive Skulls?

This mod makes it possible to see skulls/heads through blocks. There are also some experimental options that could lead to a crash and are therefore disabled by default. These can be turned on in the config menu. As this can be considered cheating on some servers, I am not responsible for any bans related to this mod. Therefore, use it at your own risk in multiplayer!

Config Options

Nonexperimental (established and works ➔ report any bugs on GitHub (make sure the experimental options are turned off)):

  • Skulls ➔ changes the RenderType of all skulls

Experimental (These sometimes target a specific game element like the wind effect of breezes but do not always have to. Additionally, these can lead to a crash):

  • ArmorCutoutNoCull
  • Outline
  • Crumbling
  • ArmorTranslucent
  • EntitySolid
  • EntitySolidZOffsetForward
  • EntityCutout
  • EntityCutoutNoCull
  • EntityCutoutNoCullZOffset
  • ItemEntityTranslucent
  • EntityTranslucentEmissive
  • EntitySmoothCutout
  • BeaconBeam
  • EntityDecal
  • EntityNoOutline
  • EntityShadow
  • DragonExplosionAlpha
  • Eyes
  • BreezeEyes
  • EnergySwirl
  • Weather
  • BlockScreenEffect
